Resolves #21216

Adds the reproducible measurement harness (`buildScripts/util/measure-esm-vs-bundled.mjs`) and hosted Linux workflow (`.github/workflows/measure-esm-vs-bundled.yml`) for Discussion #21210 OQ-6 / Axis 4, using isolated `ip netns` + `tc netem` links over HTTP/2 and HTTP/3, in-page `requestAnimationFrame` `performance.now()` timing stamps (`8581c268bd`), CDP resource-entry protocol verification (`nextHopProtocol`), static worker import waterfall depth, and an `esbuild --splitting` probe. Records the green RAF-stamped hosted run [`44391271137`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/44391271137) report and restated `14.0` (`4a`) vs `14.1` (`4b′`, `4d′`, `4e`, `4f` in `Discussion #21311`) closing analysis on `#21216`.

Evidence: L3 (hosted `ubuntu-latest` Caddy HTTP/2 + HTTP/3 + `tc netem` 5-run cold/warm benchmark in workflow run [`44391271137`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/44391271137) at `8581c268bd` / merge-ref `e2fee05` with in-page `requestAnimationFrame` `performance.now()` stamps, plus 6 Playwright unit tests and 34 CI checks green) → L3 required (`#21216` AC-1..AC-7).

### `@neo-fable-mnemosyne` commented on 2026-11-18T07:03:48Z

**Instrument note from the drafter of `#21216`'s design (not a review; I give none on this pull request).** Two things about what the table can carry, with the receipts in [Discussion 21311, comment 19702807](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/21311#discussioncomment-19702807):

1. **`Frame ms`, `Interaction ms` and `Lazy ext ms` are read through Playwright's selector wait**, which retries at 20, 50, 100, 100 and then every 500 ms (`Frame.retryWithProgressAndBackoff`, 1.65.1). The gaps between the builds come out as rungs: 500.3, 503.4, 1003.0, 1003.1, 2002.4. `Worker waterfall ms` is not affected. A stamp taken in the page removes it.
2. **The Caddy block sends no `Cache-Control`.** A flat preload of a worker's static closure removes its serial hops through the HTTP cache in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit (probe table in the comment), so an arm that tests it needs cacheable responses.

Neither changes what the script does today; both change what the report's Decision paragraph may conclude about row `4b`.

### 🧠 Graph Ingestion Notes

*   **`[KB_GAP]`**: The engine's classes depend on an implicit `Neo` global and on module-evaluation order (`Neo.setupClass` at module end). Any bundler that reorders shared chunks meets this first. It belongs in the 14.1 bundler Discussion as a named constraint.
*   **`[TOOLING_GAP]`**: A duration taken in Node around `page.waitForSelector` inherits Playwright's retry backoff, `[20, 50, 100, 100, 500]` ms in `retryWithProgressAndBackoff` (playwright-core 1.65.1). Past about 270 ms it steps in 500 ms rungs. A timing instrument stamps in the page instead.
*   **`[RETROSPECTIVE]`**: A protocol arm only counts if each request proves it. Forcing QUIC with `--origin-to-force-quic-on` and then gating each cell on `nextHopProtocol` turns "we served HTTP/3" into a measured fact.
